panels.description:
Choose one or more Hypervisors; All includes OIE scrape targets still known to Prometheus, including empty and unreachable hosts. Reset scope returns to All. Graphs follow the selected time range; range-end tables and counters use the time shown in this banner. Dashboard links keep the selected hosts, datasource and time range. Use Project or Instance for a narrower workload view and Threats for traffic attribution and feed matches.

VM disk and network panels measure the VM side of the data path through Libvirt/QEMU. Host panels measure the compute host. Ceph/RBD, physical disks, NICs and switches measure other points in the path, so their values can differ.

Reading graphs: hover for a value; use the legend to isolate a series. Last is the rightmost plotted value; Max is the highest plotted sample in this range, not an individual event maximum. Legends start with the largest Max; scroll or click a value heading to sort. Most colours identify a host or measurement and may repeat; fill intensity is a visual aid, not a health score. Collection panels explicitly colour their states.

Reading tables: all matching rows are returned. Scroll inside a table and click a column heading to sort. Linked names open the related dashboard; retained UUIDs identify rows when names repeat. Unavailable means required observations are missing or unusable. Zero is an observed value or a confirmed empty scope, never an assumed substitute for missing data.

panels.title: Exporter and collection · coverage

panels.description:
Selected-host counts over time for each collection source. Usable requires a successful scrape, successful source collection and source age between zero and the greater of three collection intervals or 60 seconds. Unusable includes failed scrapes, collection failures, never-successful and stale sources. Missing status means required source metadata is absent. Every known target belongs to one category per source; missing target inventory leaves a gap.

These are host counts, not a status assigned to the whole cluster. A zero Missing status count means no known selected hosts lack that metadata. Colour identifies state: mint usable, red unusable, grey missing. Libvirt is solid; conntrack is dashed. Source availability applies to every project on that host.
